notes: A list workflow: selectors are examples, not a claim about any live site. Check them with `dossier scrape capture <listing-url> --selector 'article'` before trusting a run. Set cadence_hours to a number of hours to make the recipe 'due' after that long, which is what `dossier scrape run --due` reads; it is 0 here so a shipped template never nags a new workspace.
